references.title: Samsung bans use of A.I. like ChatGPT for employees after misuse of the chatbot
references.aps: A. Kharpal, Samsung bans use of A.I. like ChatGPT for employees after misuse of the chatbot, CNBC (May 2, 2023).
references.read_scope: Entire public article rendered in in-app browser, including original heading/byline/date/key points and article body; no login/paywall encountered. Search/web and curl routes were blocked, then ordinary browser route succeeded.
references.claim_boundary: Samsung confirmed temporary company-PC restrictions to CNBC; the sensitive-code incident is CNBC citing Bloomberg, not an independently documented Samsung incident record.

references.title: AI Basic Act takes effect as world's first set of laws for AI
references.aps: M. Theresia, AI Basic Act takes effect as world's first set of laws for AI, Korea.net (January 22, 2026).
references.read_scope: Original heading/byline/date and complete substantive official article body. No independent all-provisions legal audit.
references.claim_boundary: Supports the January22 commencement and policy/administrative-system description. Do not repeat the headline’s comparative world-first claim as an independent legal finding; no blanket obligations assigned to every internal AI user.
